sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000012-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Harborview Regional Hospital 012 on February 14, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 5.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 1,110 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
